caption: open() copies the file's shared entry into the table and gives the process a private offset that starts at 0. A direct read of record 250 jumps to byte (250−1)×200 = 49,800, which falls in disk block 12; the offset lives in that table entry, not in the program's code.

spec.title: Open, then jump to record 250
spec.aria: A process calls open(), which copies the file entry into the table with the per-process offset at 0; a direct read of record 250 moves the offset to 49,800 bytes, which is in disk block 12, and close() drops the open count.
